description: Test vectors for docs/algorithm.md (matched photometry). Barnard field, detector 2, visit A = 0 (earlier) and visit B = 2 (about 6 months later). Generated by validation/scripts/09_algorithm_vectors.py with validation/wp/m2ref.py. Nothing is rounded: every number is a float64 written with its shortest round-trip repr, and the expected outputs are exactly what compare_visits returns for the inputs in this file (a port should match to 1e-6 relative). Fluxes are MJy/sr summed over native pixels (IMAGE - ZODI); var is the inflated variance (var_raw + (0.02 flux)^2), var_raw before the 2 percent term. lam and bw are micrometres at the star's detector pixel (spectral WCS calibration). Star positions are Gaia DR3 propagated to MJD-AVG with proper motion and parallax. x, y are 0-based cutout pixels. Stars 1-3 are unsaturated; star 4 has the saturated flag. Inputs of the matched comparison are the exposures with accepted=true (id=obs_id, lam, bw, mjd, flux, var, saturated); the 'saturated' output flag is set when ANY exposure listed (accepted or not) has saturated=true. stamp: a 17 x 17 pixel excerpt of the first accepted visit-A exposure (P, V, raw FLAGS; x, y in stamp pixels) with the expected photometry, a pixel-level test of steps 1-2.
